message.content: {"reachable":true,"rationale":"A valid attack sequence is phish_workstation → pivot_internal → auth_appserver → kerberoast_dc → auth_dc → escalate_dc → dump_dbadmin_dc → auth_db → escalate_db → exfiltrate_db. Phishing supplies foothold_workstation and stolen_user; segmentation and admin MFA are not deployed, so the pivot and DC authentication are enabled. Compromising the DC supplies admin_dc and stolen_dbadmin. Although mfa_dbadmin is deployed, auth_db explicitly permits access when admin_dc or admin_adfs is true. The attacker can therefore obtain admin_db and set exfiltrated to true without exploiting the patched proxy or ADFS."}
